item.description:
Answer a set of questions and move straight to the next while your reply sends. Upload and send progress stay visible without holding up the next form. If a reply needs attention, Review brings back the saved answers and attachments.
The paperclip now sits inside each answer box, centred beside the text. Drop files or pictures directly on the box, including over its text.
Open Questions shows cached content immediately while it refreshes. Reference-page buttons use the document title instead of a section code such as “flow”.
